item.title: Keifu – A TUI for navigating commit graphs with color and clarity
item.description:
📝 It shows a colored commit graph, commit details, and a summary of changed files, and lets you perform basic branch operations. Checking out origin/xxx creates or updates a local branch. Remote branches are displayed, but delete operations only work with local branches.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/trasta298/keifu
